messages:
Maya R.: hey support — jwt-inc is reporting 429s in ap-southeast-1 since ~10:04 UTC. They say the mobile app does short bursts of parallel requests when opening the feed. Customer sample request id: req_7f9a3c2b. Headers show x-rate-limit-remaining:0. Can we triage? paging @Nikhil K. @Diego I. :eyes:

Diego I.: got it, pulling rate-limiter metrics now. what's their org id and plan? any correlating deploys?

Maya R.: org jwt-inc, plan = standard-hosted. No deploys on their side reported. Their dashboard shows 600 RPM hard limit. They were sending bursts ~1300 RPM for a 20s window per our trace.

Priya S.: asking customer for a curl repro — told them to include `X-Request-ID` and timestamp. sent snippet:

```bash
curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Request-ID: req_7f9a3c2b" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1","input":"hello"}'
```

Maya R.: pasted their server logs, snippet:

```json
{"t":1680000000,"req":"req_7f9a3c2b","org":"jwt-inc","status":429,"msg":"quota exceeded","headers":{"x-rate-limit-limit":"600","x-rate-limit-remaining":"0","Retry-After":"45"}}
```

Diego I.: that Retry-After is 45s — shows the limiter is tripping on RPM window. Two quick ops options:
- short-term: raise their RPM quota to 900 for 1 hour
- client guidance: implement exponential backoff with full jitter and cap parallelism (suggest max 6 concurrent)

Nikhil K.: +1 on both. I'll approve a temporary bump if support creates the ticket with exact time window. Also recommend routing to `redwood-1-small` variant when we detect sustained throttle (lower token cost) as fallback.

Infra Oncall: checking limiter dashboard — see big spike 10:03:55 -> 10:04:15 from 3 distinct mobile IP blocks. No infra-wide anomalies. Could be aggressive reconnects on mobile.

RateLimitBot: Automated alert created INC-2026-347 for repeated 429 pattern. Link: https://redwood.incidents/INC-2026-347 :rotating_light:

Priya S.: customer asked whether we can implement a token-bucket burst window change instead of hard RPM. Answered: we can enable short burst allowance for mobile if they sign an SLA change.

Maya R.: customer also says they don't see anything wrong on their side; showed client library config. looks like they're opening 20 parallel streams at app cold start.

Diego I.: can we share recommended client snippet? e.g.

```js
// backoff + concurrency cap
const pLimit = require('p-limit')(6);
async function callApi(payload){
  await retry(async () => {
    return await fetch(...)
  }, { retries: 5, jitter: true, minTimeout: 200 })
}
```

Maya R.: created support ticket #SUP-12259 and requested temporary quota bump. @Nikhil K. can you confirm window?

Nikhil K.: approved. Bump to 900 RPM for jwt-inc effective now for 60 minutes. I'll add alert to revert at +1h unless escalated. :thumbsup:

Maya R.: applied patch for the customer and told them to re-run repro. They re-tested — no 429s after bump, traffic smoothed as they implemented cap. Monitoring shows remaining count rising again.

Priya S.: customer happy for now but asked for long-term: recommendations doc + SDK guidance. I'll open follow-up doc task.

Diego I.: create a short postmortem timeline and add recommended mitigations: client-side concurrency limit, retry-with-jitter, optional service-side burst allowance for mobile, and automatic fallback model variant. Assign to eng-runtime to consider soft-burst feature.

Maya R.: thanks team — closing interim incident. Will schedule 1-on-1 with jwt-inc to review client changes. cc @RateLimitBot :wave:

Infra Oncall: INC auto-closed after quota bump and monitoring stable.

Maya R.: filing notes in ticket: resolution = temp RPM bump + client fixes. follow-up: eng-runtime to evaluate soft-burst config (P1 backlog).
